entries.b1319e5a82f4d812: This business manufactures and sells cosmetics and cosmetic tools by brand category, such as prestige, fragrance and cosmetics, in China and in duty-free areas around the world (airports, city duty-free shops, etc.). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥342,244 million, accounting for 35.3% of consolidated revenue and the largest of the reportable segments. This was a 4.3% decrease from the previous year; a decline in consumption linked to deteriorating sentiment weighed on results, although a recovery was seen in the second half of the year. In China, Clé de Peau Beauté and NARS led growth, and e-commerce grew strongly during 'Double Eleven', China's largest e-commerce event. In travel retail, the shift to a business centered on travelers progressed well, but weak spending by Chinese travelers in China and South Korea continued, and revenue declined. From the fiscal year ended December 2025, this category combines the former 'China Business' and 'Travel Retail Business' into one. The main companies are Shiseido (China) Investment Co., Ltd., Shiseido Reigen Keshōhin Yūgen Kōshi, Shiseido Hong Kong Co., Ltd., Shiseidō Shōbō (Shanghai) Yūgen Kōshi and Shiseido Travel Retail Asia Pacific Pte.
